999008199.text:
船の改装も終わったし……
いよいよ……暗黒の氷海に挑戦だね！

localizations.en: The ships are all refitted... It's finally time to challenge the Dark Frozen Sea!

999008199.text:
暗黒の氷海を案内して生き延びたっていう
漁師のお爺さんからも、貴重な話を聞けましたわ

localizations.en: We even got to hear some valuable stories from that old fisherman who guided people through the Dark Frozen Sea and lived to tell the tale.

999008199.text:
それって、以前お婆さんが話してた……
いいんですか？　思い出すのも辛いはずなのに……

localizations.en: That's the person the old woman mentioned before... Are you sure it's okay? Those memories must be painful...

999008199.text:
これ以上被害を出したくなかッた……
でも、おめェらよ、本気で行くんだろ？

localizations.en: Didn't want any more casualties... But you folks, you're serious about goin', ain't ya?

999008199.text: だッたらよ、こいつを持ッてきな

暗黒の氷海の、入り口らへんの地図だ。
おらの知ッてる所までだけんどな

localizations.en: It's a map of the entrance area to the Dark Frozen Sea. Only shows what I know, though.

999008199.text:
それだけでも助かります！
ちなみに、この奥のほうにある赤い丸はなんでしょう？

localizations.en: Even that will help immensely! By the way, what's this red circle in the back area?

999008199.text:
おらが案内した冒険者たちが目指そうとした座標だ。
何があるかはおらも知らん

localizations.en: Those're the coordinates the adventurers I guided were tryin' to reach. Don't know myself what's there.

999008199.text:
それとこッちは星図、星の位置を記した地図だ。
暗黒の氷海じャ、羅針盤が効かねえ

localizations.en: And this here's a star chart—shows the positions of the stars. Compasses don't work in the Dark Frozen Sea.

999008199.text:
迷ったときは星の位置を見て方角を確認するんですね。
教えてくださって、ありがとうございます

localizations.en: So when we're lost, we check our direction using the stars. Thank you for sharing this with us.

999008199.text:
……若いもんが、無事に帰ッてきてくれりャ
それでええよ

localizations.en: ...Long as you young folk come back safe, that's all I need.

999008199.text:
あとは、頂獣レプルガルムだけど……
どんな魔物か、覚えてる？

localizations.en: Now there's just the Apexi Repulgarm... Do you remember what kind of creature it was?

999008199.text:
覚えておるとも。アレは一言で言やあバカでかい狼だ。
６本の脚で氷の上を駆ける

localizations.en: Remember it clear as day. Put simply, it's a massive wolf. Runs across the ice on six legs.

999008199.text:
６本脚の狼……
クヴァレルガともまたぜんぜん違う見た目なんだね

localizations.en: A six-legged wolf... Sounds completely different from Kvarelga.

999008199.text:
氷で身動きが取りづらいところへ襲ッてきて……
他の船はあの爪で真ッ二つにされたんじャあ……

localizations.en: It attacks when you can barely move on the ice... The other ships got torn clean in half by those claws...

999008199.text:
氷のほうは対策してきましたから、
きっと大丈夫なはず！

localizations.en: We've taken measures against the ice, so we should be fine!

999008199.text: どうせ付けるなら大きいハンマーにすればいいのに

localizations.en: If we're adding something anyway, why not make it a big hammer?

999008199.text: それだと無駄が多すぎるって話になったでしょ

localizations.en: Didn't we already discuss how that would be too wasteful?

999008199.text:
うん、分かってるよ。うぅ……でも……
ハンマーは、ロマンだから……ロマン君じゃないよ？

localizations.en: Yeah, I know. But still... hammers are all about romance... Not you, Roman.

999008199.text: アルビ号は……やっぱりお休みだよね

localizations.en: The Alvi's... gonna have to sit this one out, huh?

999008199.text:
他の２隻に比べて、少し造りが頼りないものね。
でも、ここまでよく頑張ってくれたわ

localizations.en: Compared to the other two ships, its construction is a bit less sturdy. But it's served us well up to this point.

999008199.text:
神聖国に認めてもらった証の、アタシの初めての船。
……ここまでありがとう、アルビ号

localizations.en: The first ship I earned recognition from Nova for... Thanks for everything, Alvi.

999008199.text:
では……暗黒の氷海を越えて果ての大陸まで！
いざ行かん！　やーー！！！

localizations.en: Now then... through the Dark Frozen Sea to World's End! Let's go! Yeah!
